the_one_LOST_flip_is_a_RENAME_and_that_i.claim: Exactly one body-path disappears from the flip set at BOTH levels — clean_kernel::tc::branch_sharing::{impl#1}::major_idx — and it is NOT a lost flip. The same body flips at both levels under a new path, clean_kernel::tc::branch_sharing_recursor_app::{impl#0}::major_idx.
the_one_LOST_flip_is_a_RENAME_and_that_i.why_this_needed_checking: A lane previously lost four bodies silently to an OpaqueScalar change and found it only by a by-name diff. A path-keyed delta reports a file split as a loss, so the two candidates had to be compared as BODIES, not as names.

evidence.moved_by: clean commit 1b70da9fd — 'refactor(paragon): PAY the absorbed debt' — the file split that added branch_sharing_recursor_app.rs.
evidence.identical: same instruction sequence, same functy.46, same parameter name. The three differences are the module path in the header, the callee ORDINAL (@func.4540 -> @func.4558, whole-crate renumbering — the corpus gained 25 bodies), and the #loc file/line (the code moved to a new file).
evidence.lineage_digests_differ_and_that_is_EXPEC: sha256:08bde897… -> sha256:6bd95753…. The A-LIN digest covers the per-body module, whose header carries the def path, so a rename MUST move it.
